title: Special Rate — County and City start blank and list an empty choice
requirementSource: NM-4022 — TestRail C107687: the list starts with All, has no empty choice, City shows All
stepsToReproduce: Open Tax → Special Rate for office 1606 (/navigator/locations/1606/taxes/special-rate) on e2e.
Choose State CA and open County.
Choose County ALAMEDA and open City.
expectedBehavior: County and City show All; their lists start with All and have no empty choice.
actualBehavior: County and City show blank; both lists start with an empty choice followed by All.

verificationLog.finding: Failed in the full run and the isolated rerun. Similar to BUG-TAX-ST-002 on Sales Tax (County goes blank).
